scripts.build:vercel: npm run typecheck && npm run check:localization && vite build --config vite.vercel.config.ts && node scripts/prune-vercel-assets.mjs
scripts.check:vercel: npm run build:vercel && vitest run tests/vercel-deployment.test.ts && node scripts/check-vercel-preview.mjs && npm run check:world-seams
scripts.check:full-story-local: npm run build:vercel && npm run check:full-story-local:chromium && npm run check:full-story-local:webkit
scripts.check:full-story-live: npm run check:full-story-live:chromium && npm run check:full-story-live:webkit
scripts.check:world-seam-performance-local: npm run build:vercel && npm run check:world-seam-performance-local:chromium && npm run check:world-seam-performance-local:webkit
scripts.check:world-seam-performance-live:chromi: node scripts/run-performance-reference.mjs --browser chromium --url https://game.amso.pl/ --scenario world-seam-performance-v1 --audio disabled --output .scratch/challenge-soft-world-seams/evidence/ticket-04/production-chromium.json
scripts.check:world-seam-performance-live:webkit: node scripts/run-performance-reference.mjs --browser webkit --url https://game.amso.pl/ --scenario world-seam-performance-v1 --audio disabled --output .scratch/challenge-soft-world-seams/evidence/ticket-04/production-webkit.json
scripts.check:world-seam-performance-release: npm run check:world-seam-performance-local && npm run check:world-seam-performance-live && node scripts/check-world-seam-performance-release.mjs
scripts.check:postdeploy: npm run check:vercel-live && npm run check:performance-live
scripts.check:performance-release: npm run check:vercel && npm run check:vercel-live && node scripts/check-performance-release.mjs --require-evidence
scripts.build:all: npm run build:vercel && npm run build:frames
